[ot] Guard remaining list-getter output arrays against NULL

Following GHSA-v5mv-8hhw-vff8, sweep the rest of the public "list getter"
APIs for the same defect: a NULL output array passed with a non-NULL count
on a populated table wrote through the NULL pointer and crashed (SIGSEGV).
These output params are not all annotated nullable, but the crash is
reachable from public C APIs and is a straightforward DoS, so guard the
write on the output pointer consistently (matching hb_color_line_get_color_stops
and the fixes in the previous two commits).  When the output is NULL the
getter now just returns the total count.

Getters hardened:

  - MathKern::get_entries              (hb_ot_math_get_glyph_kernings)
  - MathGlyphAssembly::get_parts       (hb_ot_math_get_glyph_assembly)
  - MathGlyphConstruction::get_variants (hb_ot_math_get_glyph_variants)
  - IndexArray::get_indexes            (hb_ot_layout_language_get_feature_indexes,
                                        hb_ot_layout_feature_get_lookups, ...)
  - RecordListOf::get_tags             (hb_ot_layout_table_get_script_tags,
                                        _get_feature_tags, _get_language_tags, ...)
  - AttachList::get_attach_points      (hb_ot_layout_get_attach_points)
  - LigGlyph::get_lig_carets           (hb_ot_layout_get_ligature_carets)
  - fvar get_axis_infos / get_axes_deprecated / get_instance_coords
                                        (hb_ot_var_get_axis_infos, hb_ot_var_get_axes,
                                        hb_ot_var_named_instance_get_design_coords)
  - OpenTypeOffsetTable / CoreText / face-builder get_table_tags
                                        (hb_face_get_table_tags)

Extend test/api/test-ot-nullable-output.c with table-tags, fvar axis-info
and MATH kerning cases; each crashed before this change.

name.value: [ot] Guard remaining list-getter output arrays against NULL

value.value: [ot] Guard remaining list-getter output arrays against NULL

[ot] Guard remaining list-getter output arrays against NULL

Following GHSA-v5mv-8hhw-vff8, sweep the rest of the public "list getter"
APIs for the same defect: a NULL output array passed with a non-NULL count
on a populated table wrote through the NULL pointer and crashed (SIGSEGV).
These output params are not all annotated nullable, but the crash is
reachable from public C APIs and is a straightforward DoS, so guard the
write on the output pointer consistently (matching hb_color_line_get_color_stops
and the fixes in the previous two commits).  When the output is NULL the
getter now just returns the total count.

Getters hardened:

  - MathKern::get_entries              (hb_ot_math_get_glyph_kernings)
  - MathGlyphAssembly::get_parts       (hb_ot_math_get_glyph_assembly)
  - MathGlyphConstruction::get_variants (hb_ot_math_get_glyph_variants)
  - IndexArray::get_indexes            (hb_ot_layout_language_get_feature_indexes,
                                        hb_ot_layout_feature_get_lookups, ...)
  - RecordListOf::get_tags             (hb_ot_layout_table_get_script_tags,
                                        _get_feature_tags, _get_language_tags, ...)
  - AttachList::get_attach_points      (hb_ot_layout_get_attach_points)
  - LigGlyph::get_lig_carets           (hb_ot_layout_get_ligature_carets)
  - fvar get_axis_infos / get_axes_deprecated / get_instance_coords
                                        (hb_ot_var_get_axis_infos, hb_ot_var_get_axes,
                                        hb_ot_var_named_instance_get_design_coords)
  - OpenTypeOffsetTable / CoreText / face-builder get_table_tags
                                        (hb_face_get_table_tags)

Extend test/api/test-ot-nullable-output.c with table-tags, fvar axis-info
and MATH kerning cases; each crashed before this change.

[harfbuzz.cc] Fix OffsetTable name clash with Mac headers

There's no easy way to undo a "using namespace" in our sources, so by the time
we get to include hb-coretext.cc from harfbuzz.cc, we already have "using namespace OT"
active, which clashes with Mac headers.

Error was:
$ gcc -O3 -Wall -arch i386 -DHAVE_CORETEXT=1 -c harfbuzz.cc -o harfbuzz.o -std=c++11
/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX.sdk/System/Library/Frameworks/CoreServices.framework/Frameworks/CarbonCore.framework/Headers/TextUtils.h:288:3: error:
      reference to 'OffsetTable' is ambiguous
  OffsetTable     offsets,
  ^
/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/SDKs/MacOSX.sdk/System/Library/Frameworks/CoreServices.framework/Frameworks/CarbonCore.framework/Headers/IntlResources.h:115:41: note:
      candidate found by name lookup is 'OffsetTable'
typedef OffPair                         OffsetTable[3];
                                        ^
./hb-open-file.hh:81:16: note: candidate found by name lookup is 'OT::OffsetTable'
typedef struct OffsetTable
               ^
1 error generated.
